name: How do I choose the right type of lighting fixtures for my home's exterior?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right type of lighting fixtures for my home's exterior?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right lighting fixtures depends on your desired aesthetic, function, and the area to be lit. Consider factors like material durability for weather resistance, light output (lumens), beam spread, and color temperature. For pathways, choose fixtures that provide adequate illumination without glare. For architectural accents, consider spotlights or wash lights. Your design professional can guide you in selecting fixtures that complement your home's style and meet performance requirements for longevity and maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select fixtures based on aesthetics, function, and area. Consider material, light output, beam spread, and color temperature for durability and performance.
